lines: Ab kahaan hoon, kahaan nahin hoon main?
couplets.en: Where am I now, and where am I not?

lines: Ab kahaan hoon, kahaan nahin hoon main?
Jis jagah hoon, wahaan nahin hoon main.
couplets.en: Where am I now, where am I not, when even where I am, I am absent?

lines: Kaun aawaaz de raha hai mujhe?
Koi keh de, yahaan nahin hoon main.
couplets.en: Whoever is calling me, someone tell them I am not here.

lines: Main hawa hoon, kahaan watan mera?
couplets.en: I am the wind, where is my home?

lines: Dasht mera, na ye chaman mera.
Main hawa hoon, kahaan watan mera?
couplets.en: Neither the desert nor this garden is mine, so where shall I, the wind, call home?

lines: Main ke har chand ek khaana-nashin.
couplets.en: And I, for all that I stay within my own four walls.

lines: Main ke har chand ek khaana-nashin.
Anjuman anjuman sukhan mera.
couplets.en: Though I keep to my room, my verse goes from gathering to gathering.

lines: Main hawa hoon, kahaan watan mera?
couplets.en: I am the wind, where is my home?

lines: Barg-e-gul par charaagh sa kya hai?
couplets.en: What is that glimmer, like a lamp on a rose petal?

lines: Barg-e-gul par charaagh sa kya hai?
Chhoo gaya tha use dahan mera.
couplets.en: That glimmer like a lamp on the rose petal is where my lips brushed it.

lines: Dasht mera, na ye chaman mera.
couplets.en: Neither the desert nor this garden is mine.

lines: Main ke toota.
Main ke toota hua sitaara hoon.
Kya bigaadegi anjuman mera?
couplets.en: What harm can the gathering do me?

lines: Dasht mera, na ye chaman mera.
Main hawa hoon, kahaan watan mera?
couplets.en: Neither the desert nor this garden is mine, so where shall I, the wind, call home?

lines: Har ghadi ek naya taqaaza hai.
couplets.en: Every moment brings a fresh demand.

lines: Dard-sar ban gaya badan mera.
couplets.en: My own body has become a burden.

lines: Dasht mera, na ye chaman mera.
Main hawa hoon, kahaan watan mera?
couplets.en: Neither the desert nor this garden is mine, so where shall I, the wind, call home?
